# Why isn't X here?

Plenty of great apps didn't make the list. Each one below was checked against [the rules](CONTRIBUTING.md#the-rules) and fails at least one, so it isn't listed. This isn't a verdict on the app or the people behind it: a project with a paid tier can still be excellent. Price Tag Zero just makes one strict promise: nothing on it costs anything, ever.

Projects change. If an app below has dropped its paid tier, moved to an OSI license or come back to life, [suggest it again](https://github.com/RandyNorthrup/price-tag-zero/issues/new?template=add-app.yml) with the new evidence.

168 apps checked and not listed, as of 2026-11-21.

**Jump to:** [Sells something (104)](#sells-something) · [Ads in the app (2)](#ads-in-the-app) · [Not OSI open source (20)](#not-osi-open-source) · [Inactive or archived (28)](#inactive-or-archived) · [No downloadable release (5)](#no-downloadable-release) · [No real GUI (2)](#no-real-gui) · [Doesn't replace paid software (7)](#doesnt-replace-paid-software)

## Ads in the app

Ads on a project's website are fine. Ads inside the app are not.

| App | Category | Would replace | Why it's not listed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [balenaEtcher](https://etcher.io/) | Disk & Partitions | UltraISO, PowerISO | The app shows a 'featured project' promo panel loaded from balena's servers while flashing (in-app ads). |
| [CrystalDiskInfo](https://crystalmark.info/en/software/crystaldiskinfo/) | Disk & Partitions | Hard Disk Sentinel Pro, HD Tune Pro | The author distributes ad-supported "Ads" installer builds of the app; only website ads are allowed. |

## Not OSI open source

The rule: an OSI-approved license, with a LICENSE file in the repo. Source-available, non-commercial and unlicensed code doesn't count, however generous.

| App | Category | Would replace | Why it's not listed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [7-Zip](https://www.7-zip.org/) | File Management | WinRAR, WinZip | unRAR restriction in the license is not OSI-approved. PeaZip is listed instead. |
| [Anytype](https://anytype.io) | Notes | Notion | Source-available license, not OSI-approved; also sells membership tiers. |
| [GitButler](https://gitbutler.com) | Developer Tools | GitKraken, Tower | Functional Source License is source-available, not OSI open source. |
| [Heynote](https://heynote.com) | Notes | Drafts | Commons Clause license, not OSI-approved. |
| [Keka](https://www.keka.io) | File Management | BetterZip, Archiver | No LICENSE file in the GitHub repo and no license detected (repo hosts releases only). |
| [Mail-in-a-Box](https://mailinabox.email) | Email | Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online) | CC0-1.0 is not an OSI-approved license. |

| [Nmap / Zenmap](https://nmap.org) | Remote Access & Networking | SolarWinds Port Scanner, NetScanTools Pro | Nmap Public Source License is not OSI-approved; project sells Nmap OEM licences. |

The rule: a desktop app or a self-hosted web app. Command-line tools and config files don't count.

## Doesn't replace paid software

The rule: it has to do the main job of a well-known paid app. These are good tools that don't.

| App | Category | Would replace | Why it's not listed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Delta Chat](https://delta.chat) | Email | WhatsApp, Slack | A messenger, not an email client; does not replace paid email software. |
| [ElectronMail](https://github.com/vladimiry/ElectronMail) | Email | Proton Mail Bridge | Client for one service (Proton Mail) only; not a general replacement for a paid email client. |
| [Multipass](https://canonical.com/multipass) | Virtualization | VMware Workstation Pro | Ubuntu-only VMs, so not a fair replacement for a general VM product; Canonical sells other products. |
| [Restic Browser](https://github.com/emuell/restic-browser) | Backup, Sync & Migration | Arq Backup | Browse/restore only ("not a fullblown restic backup GUI"), so not a fair replacement for a backup product. |
| [Sioyek](https://sioyek.info) | Office & PDF | Adobe Acrobat Reader | Reader only, does not replace a paid product; last stable release v2.0.0 (Dec 2022). |
| [SumatraPDF](https://www.sumatrapdfreader.org) | Office & PDF | Adobe Acrobat Reader, Foxit PDF Reader | Replaces free PDF readers, not paid software. |
| [Twinkle Tray](https://twinkletray.com) | System Utilities | DisplayFusion Pro | No well-known paid product it fairly replaces (main job is covered by free tools); otherwise passes. |
